Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We understand that you are fully booked and that delivery timing and firm commitments matter to you. Our rising forecast and proposed long contract term can provide planning security, and although payment terms are fixed, we pay reliably on the due date. Could this provide a basis for securing supply?

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 29.89 (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 29.95 per unit, 23400 units a year, 36 months, lead time 56 days.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

As a matter of corporate policy, we do not share internal cost breakdowns or pricing bases. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We can accommodate the requested volume of 23400 units and the 36-month contract term with a lead time of 56 days. Based on these parameters, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. Specifically, our Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for moving your offer toward us again; we appreciate the step, and understand that your full capacity and formal approval process constrain your pricing flexibility. We recognize that your calculation is internal and will not ask for a cost breakdown; our rising demand forecast and the planning security of a long contract term are part of our proposal, while the payment terms remain fixed and we pay reliably when due.

Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 31.22 per unit, 23400 units a year, 36 months, lead time 56 days.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

The parameters of a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, and a Lieferzeit of 56 days remain unchanged.

This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
